meta.title: Workspace launch defaults
meta.description: Remembers the agent preset and the provider, model, and reasoning effort that a new conversation actually used at its first message in each working directory, then applies them again to that workspace's next newly created or cold-resumed blank session. The recorded preset includes the configured default, and the recorded model includes the deployment default in effect at that moment; a workspace pins those first-message values, so changing the Settings default does not affect a workspace that already has a record. Later changes inside the same conversation do not rewrite the workspace memory. Only blank sessions are changed, a non-default preset named on purpose by the session creator is left alone, subagent sessions are always ignored, and forks are ignored by default (they participate when skipForks is false). A live blank session reused within the same process is handled directly by the Host and the plugin does not re-apply the preset; the first message there records the Host's current preset, which can overwrite the previous workspace preset preference. The model is pinned at creation, so reuse and later deployment-default changes do not affect it. Memory is stored on this host in the plugin's own storage domain, not in the session log; turning the plugin off stops both remembering and applying but keeps the stored values.
